name: Puni Loli Yu - Tsuu
source:
The public bath is renewed in this winter.
The protagonist spent all of his money in this suspicious public bath.
While reflecting on his thoughtlessness, he is handed a piece of paper by a girl.

"Our school recruits a swimming instructor. Give it a try."
Only bad feelings come into his mind, but he goes to the school...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE210520.html]DLsite English[/url]]
